title: Discourse Markers & Connectors
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Los conectores son el pegamento de la elocuencia. Usar 'Albeit', 'Notwithstanding' o 'Conversely' eleva inmediatamente el registro de tu discurso. Has demostrado que puedes hilar ideas complejas con la elegancia de un diplomático o un alto ejecutivo.

parts.visual:
1. Albeit (Aunque / Si bien): 
- Más formal que 'although'. A menudo se usa sin un verbo conjugado después. 
Ej: The new policy was successful, ALBEIT controversial. (Exitoso, aunque controvertido). 

2. Notwithstanding (A pesar de / No obstante): 
- Muy formal. Puede ir ANTES o DESPUÉS del sustantivo al que modifica. 
Ej: NOTWITHSTANDING the bad weather, the event was a success. 
Ej: The bad weather NOTWITHSTANDING, the event was a success. 

3. Conversely (Por el contrario / A la inversa): 
- Se usa para introducir una idea opuesta o inversa a la anterior. 
Ej: We could invest in tech; CONVERSELY, we could save the money.
parts.audio: Welcome to Advanced Discourse Markers. Number 1: Albeit. This is a very formal way to say 'although'. It is often used without a conjugated verb. For example: The new policy was successful, ALBEIT controversial. Number 2: Notwithstanding. This means 'despite' or 'in spite of'. Uniquely, it can go before or after the noun. For example: NOTWITHSTANDING the bad weather, the event was a success. Or: The bad weather NOTWITHSTANDING... Number 3: Conversely. This is used to introduce an opposite or reverse idea. For example: We could invest in tech; CONVERSELY, we could save the money.

parts.visual:
4. Hence / Thus (Por lo tanto / De ahí que): 
- 'Hence' se usa mucho para explicar el origen de algo (de ahí...). 
Ej: The server crashed, HENCE the delay. (De ahí el retraso). 

5. Insofar as (En la medida en que): 
- Indica el límite o grado hasta donde algo es cierto. 
Ej: The agreement is valid INSOFAR AS both parties comply. 

6. By the same token (De la misma manera / Por la misma razón): 
- Para añadir un punto que se rige por la misma lógica del anterior. 
Ej: He shouldn't be late; BY THE SAME TOKEN, you shouldn't leave early.
parts.audio: Number 4: Hence, and Thus. 'Hence' is often used to explain the origin of a situation, meaning 'that is the reason for'. For example: The server crashed, HENCE the delay. Number 5: Insofar as. This means 'to the extent that'. For example: The agreement is valid INSOFAR AS both parties comply. Number 6: By the same token. This means 'in the same way' or 'for the same reason'. For example: He shouldn't be late; BY THE SAME TOKEN, you shouldn't leave early.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el conector o marcador discursivo adecuado.

questions.question: The meeting was highly productive, ____ a bit too long. (Aunque - formal).
questions.explanation: Albeit = aunque / si bien (usualmente seguido de adjetivo/frase, no oración completa).

questions.question: The objections of the board ____, the CEO proceeded with the acquisition. (A pesar de).
questions.explanation: Notwithstanding puede ir después del sustantivo ('The objections... notwithstanding').

questions.question: Lowering prices increases volume; ____, raising prices increases profit margins. (Por el contrario).
questions.explanation: Conversely = a la inversa / por el contrario.

questions.question: We lost our biggest client, ____ the drop in revenue. (De ahí / Por eso).
questions.explanation: Hence = de ahí (que haya una caída).

questions.question: The law is only effective ____ as it is strictly enforced by the police. (En la medida en que).
questions.explanation: Insofar as = en la medida en que.

questions.question: If you demand respect from your team, by the same ____, you must respect them. (De la misma manera).
questions.explanation: By the same token = por la misma regla/razón.

questions.question: He was an excellent manager, ____ prone to losing his temper. (Si bien / Aunque).
questions.explanation: Albeit prone to = aunque propenso a.

questions.question: ____ the financial crisis, the bank managed to pay dividends. (A pesar de).
questions.explanation: Notwithstanding = a pesar de / no obstante.

questions.question: The cost of materials increased; ____, we had to raise our prices. (Por lo tanto - formal).
I am willing to help ____ as it doesn't interfere with my own work. (Hasta el punto en que).
Some argue technology isolates us; ____, others argue it connects us globally. (A la inversa).
There was a massive snowstorm, ____ the flight cancellations. (De ahí).
They bought a beautiful house in London, ____ a very expensive one. (Aunque).
His lack of experience ____, he is still the best candidate for the job. (No obstante su falta de experiencia).
questions.explanation: Notwithstanding puede ir postpuesto al sustantivo.

questions.question: You shouldn't shout at the kids; by the ____ token, you shouldn't ignore them either.
The project is complete ____ as the main construction is concerned. (En lo que respecta a).
questions.explanation: Insofar as... is concerned = en lo que respecta a.

questions.question: He failed his final exams; ____, he will not graduate this year. (Por consiguiente).
A fast car uses more fuel; ____, a slow car is more fuel-efficient. (Por el contrario).
She is a brilliant pianist, ____ largely self-taught. (Si bien / Aunque).
____ the difficulties, we managed to launch the product on time.
questions.explanation: Notwithstanding the difficulties = A pesar de las dificultades.

questions.question: Successful, ____ controversial. (Aunque - con A)
____ the rain, we went. (A pesar de - muy formal con N)
The rain ____, we went. (A pesar de - postpuesto con N)
Option A is cheap; ____, B is expensive. (Por el contrario con C)
A mistake was made, ____ the delay. (De ahí - con H)
It rained; ____, we stayed inside. (Por lo tanto con T)
____ as I know, it is true. (En la medida en que con I)
By the ____ token. (De la misma manera)
Beautiful, ____ small. (Aunque - con A)
____ the danger, he jumped. (A pesar de - con N)

pairs.target: A la inversa / Por el contrario
De ahí que / Por lo tanto
Sin embargo / A pesar de eso

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona el marcador del discurso correcto.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Notwithstanding the cost, we bought it.
options: Notwithstanding the cost, we bought it.
Not with standing the cost, we bought it.
Despite the cost, we bought it.
Understanding the cost, we bought it.
questions.correct_answer: Notwithstanding the cost, we bought it.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The server broke, hence the delay.
options: The server broke, hence the delay.
The server broke, here the delay.
The server broke, thus the delay.
The server broke, since the delay.
questions.correct_answer: The server broke, hence the delay.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is true insofar as we know.
options: It is true insofar as we know.
It is true in so far as we know.
It is true as far as we know.
It is true so far as we know.
questions.correct_answer: It is true insofar as we know.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: By the same token, don't lie.
options: By the same token, don't lie.
By the same talking, don't lie.
By the same rule, don't lie.
Buy the same token, don't lie.
questions.correct_answer: By the same token, don't lie.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: They failed; thus, they were fired.
options: They failed; thus, they were fired.
They failed; this, they were fired.
They failed; those, they were fired.
They failed; hence, they were fired.
questions.correct_answer: They failed; thus, they were fired.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: The danger not withstanding, he went.
The danger never standing, he went.
